output.summary: An evergreen succulent perennial native to southeastern Europe and Asia Minor. Its sprawling stems carry fleshy blue-green leaves, while inconspicuous spring flowers are surrounded by bright yellow bracts. Ingestion causes nausea, vomiting and diarrhea, and its milky sap can severely irritate skin and eyes.
